purpose: Consequential or irreversible actions that require a human decision. An agent reaching a required gate MUST stop, and MUST NOT reinterpret it as optional or route around it.

rules.on_reach: stop, write durable state, state exactly what the human must decide and what follows each answer

gates.trigger: merging a branch into a shared branch, or completing a pull request
tagging, publishing or releasing a version
any deployment to a production environment
history rewrite, force push, hard reset, deleting files or branches not created in this work
schema migration, data backfill, or any change to real booking, customer or payment data
sending communications, or calls to third-party services with real-world effect (payments, notifications, calendars)
adding, removing or upgrading a dependency
work beyond the declared scope of the current task
changing the salon application's architecture, or the orchestration standards in .claude/STANDARDS.md
